records.body:
Hi Owen,

Wanted to check in on Granite Analytics' setup. If you haven't gotten to inviting the rest of the team yet, no rush -- just let me know if anything's in the way.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Granite Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for setting up Granite Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and three Wrenfield emails (ad9df739, eba35caf, 171e21f0) with no customer reply at all — no engagement signal of any kind. Starter solo account; 8 days left. Silent accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: Getting Granite Analytics' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

I know you've had a few notes from me already, so I'll keep this short. Nothing's required from you today — but if the first project is still on the list, that's usually the easiest place to start, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you live, or just answer questions by email.

Best,
Priya
